vi: Dựng trần quyền (permission boundary) bằng google_iam_deny_policy để chặn tường minh mọi IAM self-escalation (setIamPolicy) và SA key creation, thắng mọi allow kể cả roles/owner.

Viết Terraform google_iam_deny_policy với denied_principals, exception_principals (break-glass SA), denied_permissions, và denial_condition bằng CEL để giới hạn scope deny theo region hay resource tag.
Kết hợp Deny policy layer với Allow binding có IAM Condition để đạt least-privilege động: deny tường minh giới hạn trần, condition trên allow cắt nhỏ grant theo ngữ cảnh (region, time, resource).
Giải thích policy evaluation order của GCP: deny được kiểm trước allow, explicit deny luôn thắng; so sánh với AWS Permissions Boundary (giao intersection vs deny thắng tất cả).
Xác định lỗ hổng permission boundary: CEL expression sai logic, exception_principals quên break-glass, condition khoá sai attribute, hoặc denied_permissions không cover hết escalation path.
en: Build a permission boundary using google_iam_deny_policy to explicitly block IAM self-escalation (setIamPolicy) and service account key creation, defeating all allows including roles/owner.

Write a Terraform google_iam_deny_policy with denied_principals, exception_principals (break-glass service account), denied_permissions, and denial_condition in CEL to scope the deny by region or resource tag.

Combine a Deny policy layer with Allow bindings that have IAM Conditions to achieve dynamic least-privilege: explicit deny sets the ceiling, conditions on allows further narrow grants by context (region, time, resource).
Explain GCP policy evaluation order: deny is checked before allow, explicit deny always wins; contrast with AWS Permissions Boundary (intersection vs. deny-always-wins semantics).

Spot permission boundary vulnerabilities: incorrect CEL logic, missing exception_principals for break-glass, conditions locked on the wrong attribute, or denied_permissions that miss an escalation vector.
